name: Cuming County, NE
findings: Cuming County has 38 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Cuming County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
65% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Cuming County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 63% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
